title: Scan observed event v2
description: An immutable barcode or RFID observation enriched with trusted source scope by a plant gateway.

eventId.description: A globally unique event identifier generated at the origin and retained across retries.

correlationId.description: Connects this observation to logs and later events in the same operation.

tenantId.description: The tenant derived from the authenticated trusted source by the gateway.

plantId.description: The plant derived from the authenticated trusted source by the gateway.

stationId.description: The station derived from the authenticated trusted source by the gateway.

sourceId.description: The enrolled browser or adapter source authenticated by the gateway; not a physical-device or operator identity.

observedAtUtc.description: The origin's UTC clock reading when it observed the identifier.

gatewayAcceptedAtUtc.description: The gateway's UTC timestamp after durable local acceptance.

identifier.description: The external identifier observed by the origin. It need not resolve to a known item.

technology.description: The technology used to read the identifier.

value.description: The identifier exactly as normalized by the producing browser or adapter.
